The attached file contains a specification, not an existing Zig source file or compiler error list. I can’t truthfully return a verified, complete, zero-error replacement from that alone: it requests a very large production language-model runtime whose correctness requires the actual source, Zig version, build configuration, and compiler/test output.[1]

Please provide the current `main.zig` file and the exact output of `zig build-exe main.zig` (including Zig version); then I can correct the concrete errors and return one complete file.
